svg.aria-label: One day of theta on the same hypothetical at-the-money call, seven days from expiration, shown for both sides of the same contract. The long position, which paid for the option, is marked down about 8 dollars, a red bar extending left from a centre line. The short position, which sold the identical option, is marked up about 8 dollars, a green bar of the same length extending right from the centre line. The two bars are mirror images: one side's loss is the other side's gain, from the identical day passing.
